_meta.description: US state security deposit return deadlines and wrongful-withholding penalties.
_meta.disclaimer: Prototype data for demonstration. Statutes change; verify against current state law before relying on it.
_meta.penalty_source: Apartments.com rental-manager chart (apartments.com/rental-manager/resources/leases/heres-how-tenant-can-sue-you-2-3x-deposit-amount), retrieved 2026-09-19. penalty_multiple = max total recovery as a multiple of the deposit; null = not verified from these sources.

states.deadline_note: 60 days after termination of tenancy and delivery of possession.
states.penalty_note: Up to 2x the deposit for wrongful withholding.

states.deadline_note: 14 days if tenant gave proper notice to terminate; 30 days if not, or if landlord deducted for damage repairs.
states.penalty_note: Up to 2x the deposit for wrongful withholding.

states.deadline_note: 14 days, excluding Saturdays, Sundays, and legal holidays. Tenant has the right to be present at final inspection.

states.deadline_note: 21 days. Itemized statement of deductions required with any retained portion.
